THE DANGEROUS REALITY

Why Black Rectangles Fail in Court

In high-profile cases like the Paul Manafort trial, attorneys drew black boxes on top of text. Anyone who selected the text and copied it to the clipboard recovered the secrets instantly.

❌ EVERYDAY TOOLS (ACROBAT / PREVIEW)

Only adds a decorative black vector rectangle on layer 5. The raw character bytes, interactive form fields (/V), and XFA XML datasets still exist in the file.

// Raw stream still contains:
/Widget /V (450-12-8899)
BT /F1 12 Tf (SSN: 450-12-8899) Tj ET
✓ REDACTLOCAL (SURGICAL ERADICATION)

Decompresses streams, surgically excises Tj/TJ character operators, burns out underlying raster image pixels, and unlinks form dictionaries with zero residual bytes.

// Content stream sanitized:
/Root /AcroForm << /Fields [] >>
BT /F1 12 Tf ( ) Tj ET
THE 3-LAYER REDACTION HORIZON

Statutory Precision. Semantic Intelligence. Total Free Will.

Regular expressions alone can't catch arbitrary patient names or clinical diagnoses, and black-box models hallucinate. RedactLocal fuses 3 layers of protection with complete user discretion.

LAYER 1: STATUTORY CORE

Deterministic Precision

15 canonical statutory formats: PAN Cards, Aadhaar, GSTIN, TAN, SSN, Passports, IFSC wire codes, Credit Cards, and bank accounts.

100% Deterministic
LAYER 2: ON-DEVICE NER

Air-Gapped Semantic NLP

Runs entirely in WebAssembly memory to extract unstructured patient/doctor names, street addresses, and clinical medical terms without cloud calls.

Zero Cloud Transmission
LAYER 3: USER FREE WILL

Absolute Discretion

Click to draw custom boxes, or uncheck any auto-detected field to keep public law firm addresses or phone numbers visible without forced over-redaction.

Human-in-the-Loop
FAIL-CLOSED ARCHITECTURE

The 7-Oracle Clean Room

MuPDF does not grade its own homework. Seven independent inspectors prove that zero residual bytes remain in the output document.

ORACLE 01
Dual Independent Parsers
Mozilla PDF.js and pypdf decompress all pages and verify 0 target glyphs survive in memory.
ORACLE 02
Raw Bytecode & Stream Scan
Every decompressed xref stream is scanned for raw ASCII, UTF-16, Hex, and Octal string representations.
ORACLE 03
AcroForm & XFA Purge
Interactive form values (/V) are nullified, 11-stream XFA XML arrays unlinked, and /Prev pointers eliminated.
ORACLE 04
Raster Pixel Burnout
Scanned PDF images have raw pixel data permanently overwritten so image enhancement forensics cannot reveal text.
ORACLE 05
Collateral Damage Guard
Ensures legitimate non-sensitive legal prose surrounding the redaction boundary is preserved intact.
ORACLE 06
Metadata & XMP Packet Wipe
Wipes author names, operating system identifiers, and embedded XML metadata packets (/Info dictionary).

🍏 First-Time macOS Launch & Gatekeeper Guide

Because RedactLocal is an open-source, air-gapped utility built with zero tracking and zero cloud telemetry, macOS Sequoia & Sonoma display a standard security notice on first download: "Apple could not verify RedactLocal is free of malware".

Option A · 1-Line Installer (Recommended)
Installs to /Applications and opens without security prompts:
curl -fsSL https://mohdashraf010897.github.io/redactlocal-public/install.sh | bash
Option B · 3-Click GUI Bypass
1. On the alert prompt, click Done.
2. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security.
3. Scroll down and click "Open Anyway".
(You only need to do this once on first launch.)
If you already dragged RedactLocal to Applications, remove the quarantine bit in Terminal: xattr -cr /Applications/RedactLocal.app
